name: Scottsdale Executive Flight Training
summary: Scottsdale Airport school that publishes its rates in a PDF and quotes dry rates.
differentiator: Quotes dry rates in a PDF, so its $144 Cessna 172N and $129 Cessna 172K look like the lowest headline rates here, but fuel, a 1% airport user fee and a 2.5% card fee come on top.
pricing: Cessna 172N at $144 an hour dry, Cessna instruction $75 an hour.
feesNamed: Airport user fee: 1% on aircraft rentals, 2.5% on flight instruction
2.5% fee on credit card payments (eCheck or ACH has no fee)
Renter's insurance required: at least $30,000 for Cessna and $100,000 for Cirrus
bestFor: Pilots and students at Scottsdale Airport who will price fuel separately.
skipIf: You want an all-in hourly figure.
watchOut: These are dry rates: fuel is extra, so add fuel before comparing with wet rates.
The pricing page shows no figures; they are in a PDF.
The PDF shows no date we could read; its file name suggests August 2026.
